focus_areas.area: S3 bucket public access (ACL, bucket policy, Block Public Access)
S3 buckets: TLS enforcement (aws:SecureTransport) and versioning for audit/log buckets
RDS instance public exposure and encryption
AMI image sharing and snapshot exposure
Load balancer (ALB) TLS policy and WAF association
Unencrypted data in transit and at rest

rule.title: S3 Public Bucket
rule.description: S3 buckets with public ACL or bucket policy allowing anonymous access are Critical
rule.action: Check s3:GetObject, s3:ListBucket permissions for Principal: "*"

rule.title: S3 Block Public Access
rule.description: Block Public Access settings should be enabled at account AND bucket level
rule.action: Verify all four Block Public Access settings are True

rule.title: RDS Public Exposure
rule.description: RDS instance with PubliclyAccessible=true is Critical if internet-exposed
rule.action: Check PubliclyAccessible flag and security group ingress from 0.0.0.0/0

rule.title: RDS Encryption
rule.description: RDS instance without encryption at rest is High risk
rule.action: Check StorageEncrypted flag for all DB instances

rule.title: AMI Sharing
rule.description: AMI shared with account: "all" (public) is Critical
rule.action: Identify public AMIs and determine if intentional

rule.title: CloudFront Origin
rule.description: CloudFront distribution with unencrypted origin connection is High
rule.action: Check OriginProtocolPolicy: must be https-only, not http-only

rule.title: EBS Snapshot Sharing
rule.description: EBS snapshots shared with all accounts or public are Critical
rule.action: Check snapshot CreateVolumePermissions for public access

rule.title: S3 TLS Enforcement
rule.description: Critical buckets should explicitly deny non-TLS access (aws:SecureTransport=false)
rule.action: Check bucket policies for a Deny with Condition Bool aws:SecureTransport=false

rule.title: S3 Versioning (Audit/Logs)
rule.description: Audit/log buckets should have versioning enabled to protect log integrity
rule.action: Check bucket Versioning status; recommend Object Lock for high assurance

rule.title: S3 Cross-Account Bucket Policy
rule.description: Bucket policies granting access to principals in other AWS accounts must be justified and constrained
rule.action: Identify bucket policy statements with Principal AWS arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:root/role/user from other accounts; require conditions (aws:SourceAccount/aws:SourceArn) where applicable

rule.title: ALB TLS Policy
rule.description: Internet-facing ALBs must not allow obsolete TLS 1.0/1.1
rule.action: Check HTTPS listeners and their SslPolicy

rule.title: ALB WAF Association
rule.description: Internet-facing ALBs for public apps should have WAF associated
rule.action: Only emit this finding if you see an internet-facing ALB AND evidence shows no WAF association for that ALB

evidence_focus.note: Evidence files are indexed documents (items + by_id/by_name). Use these indexes for evidence_refs (e.g., security-groups.json#by_id.sg-..., s3-buckets.json#by_name.bucket). Do NOT assume a control fails just because a file is missing; only report based on explicit evidence.

focus.check: Buckets with PublicAccessBlockConfiguration not fully enabled
Bucket policies allowing s3:GetObject with Principal: "*"
ACL set to PublicRead or PublicReadWrite
Bucket policies missing Deny on aws:SecureTransport=false (TLS enforcement)
Audit/log buckets with Versioning not Enabled
PubliclyAccessible = true combined with internet-routable security group
Snapshots shared with all AWS accounts
Images with LaunchPermission allowing all accounts
Viewer protocol policy allowing HTTP (not HTTPS-required)
HTTPS listeners with obsolete SslPolicy (TLS 1.0/1.1 allowed)
Internet-facing ALB without any associated WAFv2 WebACL

irrefutable_evidence_guide.requirement: Every Exposure finding MUST include in evidence_snippet the exact AWS metadata that proves the claim:

for_s3_public.field: For bucket policies: exact Principal and Action that allow public access
For ACLs: exact Grantee field showing "AllUsers" or "AuthenticatedUsers"

for_rds_exposure.field: VPC SecurityGroups: exact Ingress rules showing port access from 0.0.0.0/0

for_ami.field: ImageId and LaunchPermission JSON showing explicit account IDs or "Public":"true"

for_resource_policies.field: CRITICAL: For Principal:* findings, include the ENTIRE Principal/Condition block
If Principal:* exists without Condition, generate a concrete replacement policy JSON:
Example: Principal: {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:role/SERVICE_ROLE"} with specific service role appropriate for the resource type
Show the exact permissions (s3:GetObject, sqs:SendMessage, etc.) that should be allowed

for_tls_policies.field: SslPolicy field showing minimum TLS version (e.g., "ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS-1-2-2017-01")
